reasoning_summary.description: 2-5 sentences: what the planner concluded from the last executor report and why it chose this status.

next_instruction.description: Required when status=continue. One self-contained instruction for the executor. Include acceptance criteria.

question.description: Required when status=needs_user or blocked. The exact question for the human. For plan_ready, the full plan text.

final_report.description: Required when status=done. What was accomplished, what was verified, what remains (if anything).

use_skills.description: A LIST of skill names the executor must invoke before doing this instruction, for example ["code-review"]. Empty list or absent when none are needed.

request_executor_rollover.description: Set true if the executor seems to be drifting or repeating; the orchestrator will restart it from a handoff summary.
